{{Top|leg}}
'''Joyride Group''' was the name given to the members of [[Wraith Squadron]] who were responsible for stealing two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] during the [[Mission to Storinal]].

Upon arriving on Storinal, group consisted of [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] playing Senator-in-Exile [[Iskit Tyestin]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] and his entourage of [[Falynn Sandskimmer]], [[Atril Tabanne]] and [[Voort saBinring]] as guards. Joyride Group would be joined by the members of [[Yokel Group]] for their starfighter theft.
